content.text: No exclusivity binding the Customer exists; the agreement expressly disclaims it.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Services clause (p0001) expressly negates exclusivity and confirms AP may continue offering or selling Inventory through other agents or third parties, so our freedom to source and monetize elsewhere is fully preserved. A full-text sweep for "exclusive", "sole" and third-party restriction language found no sole-supplier, all-requirements or non-procurement covenant binding AP: the remaining hits are a non-exclusive license grant in our favor (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction (p0064), each party's own trademark ownership (p0065), and the standard no-third-party-beneficiary clause (p0073). This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer); no redline required.
